title: Oscillatory pipe flow and gel shear resonances: Womersley wall force vs frequency (frequency response, mixed u-p, analytic)
description:
A pipe of radius R = 1 mm, axisymmetric (r, z) with the axis on x_lo, a short section 0 < z < L = R / 10 of it: medium driven by a uniform axial body_force f_y = f = 100 N/m^3 (a harmonic pressure gradient -dp/dz in the Womersley problem, applied here as a body force so the pressure stays 0), solid_mechanics on quadratic triangles with formulation mixed (Taylor-Hood P2 / P1, incompressible: no bulk modulus), frequency_response study. The sweep over the parameter gel switches the medium: gel = 1 a soft low-loss gel (library water with shear_modulus G0 = 1 kPa, mechanical_loss_factor 0.05 and the water viscosity), 201 log-spaced frequencies 50 Hz - 1.6 kHz through its first three radial shear resonances; gel = 0 library water (G0 = 0: a Newtonian liquid, Womersley flow), 25 log-spaced frequencies 0.1 - 200 Hz, Womersley number alpha = R sqrt(omega rho / mu) from 0.79 to 35 (Stokes layer delta = sqrt(2 mu / (rho omega)) = R sqrt(2) / alpha down to 40 um). Holds: the wall x_hi (r = R) fixed; the end faces y_lo, y_hi (z = 0, L) by a displacement feature with u_x = 0 and u_y empty, so u_r = 0 and u_z free (zero axial traction): NOT a roller or symmetry, which would hold the normal u_z and block the flow. The exact field u_r = 0, u_z(r), p = 0 is independent of z and meets these end conditions exactly (sigma_zz = -p + 2 G* du_z/dz = 0, the shear sigma_rz carried by the u_r hold), so a short section of the pipe has no end effects (line curve u_z_end_re on the end face, max |p| below; L = R / 2 gives the same errors). Mesh: 50 um triangles (R / 20, ~14 per shear wavelength of the gel at 1.6 kHz), for water 8 um inside the wall layer R - 120 um < r < R (5 elements per delta at 200 Hz, growth 1.25; 1,400 triangles), the gel uniform (240 triangles). About 4 s on the cpu backend (201 + 25 SuperLU factorisations).
Analytic (exp(+j omega t), linear viscoelastic medium, correspondence principle): G*(omega) = G0 (1 + j eta) + j omega mu, u = u_z(r) e_z with div u = 0 and p = 0, so -rho omega^2 u_z = G* (u_z'' + u_z' / r) + f, u_z(R) = 0, u_z regular on the axis: u_z(r) = u_p (1 - J0(k r) / J0(k R)), u_p = -f / (rho omega^2) the plug displacement of the core (inertia against f), k^2 = rho omega^2 / G* complex (either root: J0 and J1(z) / z are even); water k R = alpha (1 - j) / sqrt(2). Mean displacement <u_z> = u_p (1 - 2 J1(k R) / (k R J0(k R))) (the disc mean of J0(k r) is 2 J1(k R) / (k R)). Wall reaction (the force the fixed wall exerts on the medium, the table of 'walls'; ring sum, N): the global balance -rho omega^2 V <u_z> = f V + F gives F = -F_0 2 J1(k R) / (k R J0(k R)), F_0 = f pi R^2 L the body force on the section (the same as 2 pi R L G* u_z'(R)). Limits: low frequency F -> -F_0 (Poiseuille / static gel: the wall carries the whole load), water F -> -F_0 (1 - j alpha^2 / 8); water at alpha >> 1 F -> -F_0 (delta / R) (1 - j) (the core moves as a plug, the Stokes layer carries the wall shear) and the profile overshoots the plug near the wall (Richardson annular effect: u_z / u_p = 1.07 at r = 0.9 R, 200 Hz); gel: |F| peaks at the radial shear resonances J0(k R) = 0, f_n = j_0n c / (2 pi R) = 383, 879, 1379 Hz (c = sqrt(G0 / rho) = 1.0 m/s, widths ~ (eta + omega mu / G0) f_n), dips at J1(k R) = 0 (610, 1118 Hz). The closed form was checked against these limits and against a second-order finite-volume solve of the radial ODE (errors falling 4x per halving, wall force to 1e-9 after Richardson) before trusting it.
Curves & tables tab: the reaction table walls, F_y_re and F_y_im versus frequency with the analytic curves F_y_re_womersley / F_y_im_womersley (per sweep value; the Sweep tab overlays both media); the derived curve wall_force_ratio = |F| / F_0 per table row (log-spaced frequencies, so the reference maps the row to its frequency) over its analytic magnitude |2 J1 / (k R J0)| (the last sweep value, water: the roll-off from 1 to 0.056). Line profile tab (the last frequency of the last sweep value, water at 200 Hz): u_z_mid_re / u_z_mid_im (Re and Im of u_z along r at z = L / 2) and u_z_end_re (the end face z = 0: the same profile, no end effect). Derived values (per sweep value, at its last frequency unless noted): u_z / u_p at r = R / 50, 0.6 R, 0.9 R (water 1, 1, 1.069; gel 4.82, 1.62, 0.597), the mean <u_z> / u_p (an integral with ring weights; 0.960, 1.024), -Re F / F_0 at the middle row f_mid = sqrt(f_lo f_hi) (water 4.5 Hz, alpha 5.3: 0.268; gel 283 Hz, below the first resonance: 1.837), |F| / F_0 and -Im F / F_0 at the last, and max |p| / (f R) (exact 0). Measured agreement (worst of both media, gel unless noted): u_z 3e-5 (axis, middle), 2e-5 (0.9 R), mean 8e-6, wall force 5e-5 (|F|), 8e-6 (Im), 7e-9 (middle row: the reaction is the variationally consistent wall flux, superconvergent), reaction curves 4e-6 of their range, max |p| 2.5e-4 of f R (water 2e-5), water profiles 3e-5 (Re), 1.3e-4 (Im) of the range, derived curve 4e-8 (water); halving / doubling h (gel R / 10, 20, 40; water also 16, 8, 4 um in the layer) shows P2 / P1 discretisation error (gel u_z on the axis 5.6e-4, 3.0e-5, 9.5e-7, reaction curves 2.2e-4, 4.3e-6, 3.2e-7; max |p| 1.2e-3, 2.5e-4, 5.6e-5; water Im profile 7.1e-4, 1.3e-4, 1.9e-5). Tolerances 3-6x the measured errors (pointwise P2 values are not monotone in h).

parameters.name: R_p
parameters.description: pipe radius

parameters.name: L_p
parameters.description: length of the modelled section (the exact field is z independent)

parameters.name: f_b
parameters.description: axial body force density [N/m^3] (= a pressure gradient amplitude -dp/dz [Pa/m])

parameters.name: mu_w
parameters.description: water viscosity [Pa s] (the library value; also in the gel)

parameters.name: rho_w
parameters.description: density [kg/m^3] (the library water value; also the gel)

parameters.name: G_g
parameters.description: relaxed shear modulus G0 of the gel [Pa] (soft agarose-like gel)

parameters.name: eta_g
parameters.description: mechanical loss factor of the gel

parameters.name: gel
parameters.description: medium switch (swept): 1 = gel, 0 = water (G0 = 0)

parameters.name: G_re
parameters.description: Re G* = G0 of the medium [Pa] (0 for water)

parameters.name: f_lo_w
parameters.description: water: lowest frequency [Hz] (alpha = 0.79)

parameters.name: f_hi_w
parameters.description: water: highest frequency [Hz] (alpha = 35, delta = 40 um)

parameters.name: n_w
parameters.description: water: number of log-spaced frequencies

parameters.name: f_lo_g
parameters.description: gel: lowest frequency [Hz] (k R = 0.31, near static)

parameters.name: f_hi_g
parameters.description: gel: highest frequency [Hz] (between the 3rd and 4th resonance)

parameters.name: n_g
parameters.description: gel: number of log-spaced frequencies (1.7 % steps, ~3 per resonance width)

parameters.name: f_lo
parameters.description: first frequency of the medium [Hz]

parameters.name: f_hi
parameters.description: last frequency of the medium [Hz] (the shown fields)

parameters.name: n_f
parameters.description: number of frequencies of the medium

parameters.name: f_mid
parameters.description: middle frequency of the medium [Hz] (row (n_f - 1) / 2 of the log-spaced list)

parameters.name: Gi_mid
parameters.description: Im G* at f_mid [Pa]

parameters.name: Gi_hi
parameters.description: Im G* at f_hi [Pa]

parameters.name: u_p
parameters.description: plug displacement -f / (rho omega^2) at f_hi [m]

parameters.name: F_0
parameters.description: body force on the section f pi R^2 L [N]

parameters.name: r_0
parameters.description: radius of the near-axis point

parameters.name: h_max
parameters.description: largest triangle size

parameters.name: h_stokes
parameters.description: water: triangle size in the wall layer (delta(200 Hz) / 5)

parameters.name: h_wall
parameters.description: wall-layer triangle size of the medium (the gel has no boundary layer: uniform h_max)

parameters.name: w_layer
parameters.description: width of the refined wall layer (3 delta at 200 Hz)
